title: Secret passed as a build argument via ARG DB_PASSWORD (dockerfile) — review required
description: The Dockerfile declaration ARG DB_PASSWORD accepts a credential-shaped value at build time. Build arguments are visible in the build history, in intermediate layers when expanded, and to anyone who can rebuild the image. Use BuildKit secret mounts instead (a BuildKit secret mount). This lexical rule flags the declaration.
remediation: Remove ARG DB_PASSWORD and pass the value with a BuildKit secret mount (a BuildKit secret mount).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches a credential-shaped argument name; whether a value is ever supplied is out of scope.
